δουλοσύνην: δουλοσύνη — slavery, servitude; fem. acc. sg., epic

θάμνῳ: θάμνος — bush, thicket; masc. dat. sg.
θάνοιεν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. opt. 3 pl. (θανεῖν): ’might die’, in a clause after ὅπως
θέειον: θέειον — sulphur; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖον)
θήϊον: θήϊον — sulphur; neut. acc. sg., epic variant of θέειον (= Attic θεῖον)

θεινέμεναι: θείνω — strike, smite; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic θείνειν), as a command: ’strike’

θόλου: θόλος — round building, rotunda; masc. gen. sg.

καθαίρειν: καθαίρω — cleanse, clean; pres. inf. act., in an order: ’to clean’

λίστροισιν: λίστρον — shovel, scraper; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), instrumental: ’with scrapers’
λύθρῳ: λύθρον — gore, defiling blood; neut. dat. sg.
μίσγοντό: μίσγω — mix, mingle; mid. consort with, lie with; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμίσγοντο)
νέκυάς: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. pl. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
ξίφεσιν: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. pl., with ν-movable (= ξίφεσι)
ξαίνειν: ξαίνω — card, comb (wool); pres. inf. act.: ’to card’
ξῦον: ξύω — scrape, scour; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔξυον): ’were scraping’
οἴκτιστα: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. superlative οἴκτιστος, adverbial: ’most pitiably’
πάσαις: πᾶς — all, every; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with δειρῇσι
παρήϊά: παρήϊον — cheek; neut. nom. pl., epic (cf. Attic παρειά), accent from the following enclitic τε
πεντήκοντά: πεντήκοντα — fifty; numeral, indecl. (accent from the following enclitic τοί)
πεπάλακτο: παλάσσω — splash, smear; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was smeared’, with acc. of respect
πεπυκασμένος: πυκάζω — cover closely, wrap; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’wrapped, covered’ (+ dat.)
περίβαλλε: περιβάλλω — throw around; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= περιέβαλλε), with gen.: ’threw around’
πρόθυρόν: πρόθυρον — porch, forecourt, gateway; neut. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
σήμαινε: σημαίνω — give orders, direct; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐσήμαινε): ’gave the orders’
σημαίνειν: σημαίνω — give orders, bear rule; pres. inf. act., with ἐπί + dat.: ’to give orders to, rule over’
στείνει: στεῖνος — narrow place, tight space; neut. dat. sg.
στῆθός: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)

τίθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτίθεσαν): ’were laying down, set down’
τίουσαι: τίω — honour, respect; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’honouring’

ἄνωχθε: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 pl. with present sense: ’bid!’

ἐξάψας: ἐξάπτω — fasten to, tie from; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fastened’

ἐπέβησαν: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, enter upon; aor. 3 pl., with gen.: ’have gone in for’
ἐπέγειρε: ἐπεγείρω — rouse, wake; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
ἐπεντανύσας: ἐπεντανύω — stretch tight, draw taut; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having pulled taut’
ἐπισπέρχων: ἐπισπέρχω — urge on, press hard; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’hurrying, pressing on’
ἐρείδουσαι: ἐρείδω — press, prop, lean; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’pressing against’ (one another)
ἐσιέμεναι: εἰσίημι (mid. εἰσίεμαι) — hasten into, strive to enter; pres. inf. mid., epic -μεναι (= Attic εἰσίεσθαι)
ἐφόρεον: φορέω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, augmented (= Attic ἐφόρουν): ’were carrying’
ἑστήκῃ: ἵστημι — set up; perf. ἕστηκα stand; perf. subj. 3 sg.: ’stands’
ἕρκει: ἕρκος — fence, enclosure; also a net or snare; neut. dat. sg.
ἕρκεος: ἕρκος — fence, enclosure; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕρκους)
ἕσταθ: ἵστημι — set up; perf. ἕστηκα stand; perf. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἕσταθ’ = ἕσταθι): ’stand!’

ἤσπαιρον: σπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; impf. 3 pl., with augment ἠ- (= Attic ἔσπαιρον): ’were gasping, twitching’
ἱεμένην: ἵεμαι — hasten, be eager; pres. part. mid. fem. acc. sg.: ’eager’
ἴθυσέν: ἰθύω — rush straight, be eager; aor. 3 sg. with ν-movable (accent from the following enclitic), + inf.: ’was eager to’
ὀλολύξαι: ὀλολύζω — cry out, ululate (in triumph or prayer); aor. inf. act.: ’to cry out’
ὀλοφυρόμεναι: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’wailing’

ὤϊξεν: οἴγω (ἀνοίγω) — open; aor. 3 sg., epic ὤϊξε(ν) with ν-movable (= Attic ἀνέῳξε): ’opened’

__broaden__.πᾶν: πᾶς — all, whole; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πεδίον: ’the whole (plain)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a plain substantive: ’all, everything’ (οὔ πω πᾶν εἴρηθ’ ’not yet had everything been said’) · also neut. nom. sg., attributive: ’all, the whole’ (πᾶν στῆθος ’the whole chest’)
__broaden__.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ (ἀ- + root of ἔννεπε ’tell’) · also agreeing with οὖδας: ἄσπετον οὖδας ’the vast ground’ · also agreeing with αἷμα: ’vast, endless (blood)’
__broaden__.χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’) · also pres. imper. 2 sg., plain ’rejoice’, not a greeting (ἐν θυμῷ … χαῖρε ’rejoice in your heart’)
__broaden__.ἀνέχεσθαι: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. endure, put up with; pres. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’endure’ · also pres. inf. mid. dependent on impersonal ἔστιν: ’(not) possible to put up with’ (οὔ πως ἔστιν … ἀνέχεσθαι) · also pres. inf. mid. dependent on a verb of teaching: ’to put up with’ (δουλοσύνην ἀνέχεσθαι ’to endure servitude’)
__broaden__.ἓ: ἕ, οὗ, οἷ — him, her, it(self); 3rd-person pron., acc. sg., reflexive, with αὐτόν: ’himself’ · also reflexive acc. sg. after a preposition, without αὐτόν: ’himself’ (εἰς ἓ καλεσσάμενος ’calling to himself’)
__broaden__.δάπεδον: δάπεδον — floor, ground; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object of a verb: ’the floor’
__broaden__.παρά: παρά — beside, from beside; preverb standing apart from its verb in tmesis (παρά … ἤπαφε = παρήπαφε ’led astray’); accented before an enclitic · also prep. + dat.: ’beside, among, with’ (παρά τε μνηστῆρσιν ’and beside the suitors’)
__broaden__.τάμνον: τάμνω (epic for τέμνω) — cut; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἐκ: ’they cut out’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό: ’they cut off’ (τοῦ δ’ ἀπὸ … τάμνον)
__broaden__.ἐξέρυσαν: ἐξερύω — draw out, drag out; aor. 3 pl. act., gnomic in a simile: ’have drawn out’ · also aor. 3 pl. in plain narrative: ’they dragged out’
__broaden__.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’on whom, to whom’ (τῇ τις θεὸς ὕπνον ἐπῶρσε ’on whom some god had stirred sleep’)
